cases.name: session
cases.command: if /usr/bin/python3 -c "import os,sys; sys.exit(0 if os.getsid(0)==int(sys.argv[1]) else 1)" $$; then echo session=own; else echo session=inherited; fi

cases.name: pgroup
cases.command: if /usr/bin/python3 -c "import os,sys; sys.exit(0 if os.getpgrp()==int(sys.argv[1]) else 1)" $$; then echo pgroup=own; else echo pgroup=inherited; fi

cases.name: ctty
cases.command: t=$(ps -o tty= -p $$ | tr -d ' '); if [ "$t" = "??" ]; then echo ctty=none; else echo ctty=present; fi

cases.name: devtty
